3+1 国际交流项目奖学金

title: Drexel University
德雷塞尔大学
note: Named to the Dean’s List during the visiting exchange at Drexel University’s College of Design, ranking in the top 5%.
在德雷塞尔大学设计学院访问交换期间入选 Dean’s List，成绩位列学院前 5%。

title: 11th China Higher Education Design Competition · QUIPU
第十一届中国高等院校设计作品大赛 · QUIPU
note: QUIPU combines traditional knot-making with AI. Participants tie knots to express emotion; AI translates each knot into projected text and offers a guiding response. The installation explores how tactile action can carry personal information across expression, interaction and symbolism.
QUIPU 是一件结合传统绳结技艺与 AI 的交互装置。参与者以打结表达情绪，AI 将绳结转化为投影文字并给出引导性回应。作品以可触摸的行动串联信息、交互与象征：绳结既是身体动作，也是情绪符号；AI 与投影则让这一表达被感知、被回应。

title: Shanghai University Laboratory Safety Creative Design Competition · Yanyan
上海市高校实验室安全主题文创设计大赛 · 验验
note: Yanyan is an intelligent robot mascot designed as a laboratory safety assistant, supporting researchers through safety training and timely reminders.
“验验”以智能机器人为形象，作为实验室安全助手，为研究人员提供安全培训与场景化提示。

title: Milan Design Week · China University Design Exhibition · Ariel
米兰设计周—中国高校设计学科优秀作品展 · Ariel
note: Ariel is a service system that turns ocean plastic into eco-fashion products. It invites fishers and beach visitors to join cleanup activities, then transforms recovered material into products for rental or purchase—connecting environmental reconciliation, local industry and responsible tourism.
Ariel 构建“海洋塑料垃圾—环保时尚产品”的服务系统：鼓励渔民与海滩游客参与清理，将回收材料转化为可租赁或购买的可持续产品，形成环境修复、本地产业与负责任旅游之间的闭环。

title: MUSE Design Awards · AURA
MUSE Design Awards · AURA
note: AURA explores driver fatigue in autonomous-driving scenarios. It combines driving-state data with physiological and behavioural signals, then uses personalised music and responsive feedback to help drivers maintain attention.
AURA 面向自动驾驶场景中的驾驶疲劳体验，结合驾驶状态与生理、行为信号识别疲劳程度，并设计动态音乐干预机制，以个性化音乐与交互反馈帮助驾驶者维持注意力。

title: NYU Shanghai · Digital Innovation Challenge
上海纽约大学 Digital Innovation Challenge
note: A voice-first autonomous AI 3D-modelling agent for everyday creation—from shaping game characters to arranging furniture virtually. The concept was recognised for extending 3D modelling beyond specialist tools, while acknowledging that large-scale technical adaptation remains in development.
项目提出以语音为主导的自主 AI 3D 建模智能体，可用于游戏角色塑造、家具虚拟摆放等日常场景。尽管大规模适配仍在研发中，这一让建模走出专业工具、进入生活的创意获得了最佳人气奖。

title: Undergraduate Industry Practice
本科生产业实践
note: Recognised for field research on AI in healthcare, including interviews, case synthesis and written analysis of industry applications and trends.
因智能医疗产业实践获评优秀个人，工作包括企业走访、访谈整理、案例研究及行业趋势分析。

prize: 唯一一等奖 · 奖金 18,888 元
title: Silkroad Visual · First AI Design Innovation Competition · Emotion of the City
丝路视觉首届 AI 设计创意大赛 · Emotion of the City
note: Emotion of the City explores future robots in everyday urban life. AI-generated cities, robots and daily scenes are used to imagine behaviours and relationships among people, machines and the city, forming a speculative experience of human–machine coexistence.
Emotion of the City 围绕“未来机器人 × 城市生活”展开体验设计，以 AI 生成技术构建城市、机器人与日常场景，从人与机器、机器与城市的关系出发，探索未来城市中的人机共生体验。

title: 8th Huichuang Youth · Internet+ Cultural Creativity
第八届“汇创青春” · 互联网+文化创意类
note: Second Prize in the Internet+ Cultural Creativity category of the eighth Huichuang Youth competition.
获第八届“汇创青春”上海大学生文化创意作品展示活动互联网+文化创意类二等奖。

title: Undergraduate Social Practice
本科生社会实践
note: Team recognition for field research evaluating thirty years of reforestation in Yan’an and communicating its ecological, economic and social outcomes.
延安市退耕还林三十年绩效评价项目获本科生社会实践优秀团队二等奖，研究并传播其生态、经济与社会成效。
